title: feat(fallk1): all-face-slide keeps k=1 reverse: t=3 vs t=5
science: Introduces the all-face-slide rule phi = nu + cost 3 on EVERY 2->2 hop (strictly stronger than mu). At k=1 on B_6: t=3 vs 5, 27>25, reverse holds. The note is honest that the k=1 geodesic uses no 2->2 hop at all, so phi and nu coincide here -- the clause is untested at this scale.
